title: ENABLE dispatch: eliminate second hardcoded IMAP4rev2 literal and format! alloc
description:
In the CommandBody::Enable arm (mod.rs lines 472-481), handle_enable returns bool but the caller then unconditionally pushes CapabilityEnable::try_from("IMAP4rev2") — hardcoding the capability name a second time independently of what was passed in. This means:

1. The string "IMAP4rev2" must be kept in sync between handle_enable's match arm and the push in the dispatch arm. Adding a second enableable capability requires updating both places.
2. format!("{cap}") on line 474 allocates a heap String just to do a case-insensitive string compare. cap is already a CapabilityEnable — the conversion to String is unnecessary overhead on the hot path.

Preferred fix: change handle_enable to return Option<CapabilityEnable<'static>> instead of bool — Some(cap) when newly activated, None otherwise. The dispatch arm then pushes the returned value directly, eliminating the second hardcoded literal and the format! allocation entirely.

Affected: crates/imap/src/session/mod.rs lines 472-481, 707-715.
